scope: Permanent self-healing Dhan token auto-renewal engine and multi-tier resilience: auto-recovery from expired tokens, proactive pre-emptive renewal before expiry, multi-tier fallback ladder, permanent PAPER mode safety, zero token leakage, rate-limit cooldown handling, and prevention of future BLOCKED states.
limitations: Read-only/analyzer-only Dhan credential rotation; live trading locked to OFF; no real broker orders; PAPER mode enforced.

requirements.description: Auto-recovery from expired or missing token: when old token is expired or missing, auto-rotation mints and validates a fresh token via DhanLogin and profile probe without system interruption.
Proactive pre-emptive renewal before expiry: watchdog proactively rotates expiring tokens (<= 3.0h remaining) before they ever expire, and skips healthy tokens.

Multi-tier fallback and resilience: fast in-session renew fallback to PIN+TOTP minting; Cloud Run API failure fallback to in-process canonical rotation; Secret Manager failure fallback to local vault/.secrets/dhan.env.

Permanent PAPER safety, zero secret leakage, and order authority lockout: LIVE_ORDER_AUTHORITY=0, LIVE_TRADING_ENABLED=0, ORDER_PLACEMENT_ALLOWED=false under all conditions, with zero token/secret leakage.
Comprehensive test suite pass: all Dhan tests pass with zero regressions, and rate-limit/cooldown handling prevents future deadlocks.
